profile_clarifications.L5: plaintext_lora_adamw — reference for L12; MUST use identical mixed precision (BF16 fwd/bwd, FP32 LoRA master, FP32 AdamW m/v, identical loss scaling, wd, init, batches)
profile_clarifications.L12-N: trusted_adamw_bf16_parameter_storage_negative_ablation (unstable, top1=0.905; retained as precision negative control, never main)

shared_config_inherited_from_registry.lora_init: rank_masked_orthogonal_U seed 7000+l*10+idx (deterministic; seed argument varies batch/data order only, NOT init unless registered)

PREREGISTERED_PASS_CRITERIA.note: recorded BEFORE inspecting any mixed-precision result, per instruction. Comparison is ALWAYS L12(BF16-compute/FP32-master) vs L5(plaintext, IDENTICAL BF16-compute/FP32-master) — never vs pure-FP32 or pure-BF16.

phase3_one_step.rationale: BF16 fwd/bwd injects ~1e-3 relative activation/gradient noise IDENTICALLY into both L5 and L12; residual L12-vs-L5 disagreement beyond this band would indicate a protocol (not precision) defect. Both arms share the SAME bf16 gradient, so the trusted un-fold->FP32-AdamW->re-fold path must track the plaintext FP32-AdamW to within re-fold round-off (~bf16 eps on the re-folded runtime copy).

phase5_fifty_step.restart_continuity: post-restart trajectory must match uninterrupted reference within phase4 per-step band

invalidation_conditions.offline_fp64_substitution: any L12 hardware cell that substitutes an offline FP64/plaintext optimizer simulation for the real A10 GPU fwd/bwd + real TDX enclave AdamW is INVALID
invalidation_conditions.wrong_reference: comparing L12 mixed-precision against a pure-FP32 or pure-BF16 reference and calling it equivalent is INVALID
